stories.title: Carrying the Name
stories.detail: Alan and Arthur go about their business quietly, but the Jong name is all over this board.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Richard Allsopp - great to have Royal Sydney GC with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: From the Movies
stories.detail: Dean Cooper said show me the trophy and the scoreboard answered with 4 pts.
